description: This file defines API utility functions for interactions with a backend service, including HTTP methods (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE), and specific functions for managing work items and comments in a project management context.

methods.name: withAuthHeaders(extra = {})
methods.description: Helper to build headers with Authorization token if available.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Send a DELETE request to the backend and parse the response.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Send a POST request with JSON body to the backend and parse the response.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Send a GET request with optional query parameters and parse the response.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Send a PATCH request with JSON body to the backend and parse the response.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetch comments associated with a specific work item.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Add a comment to a specific work item with optional author attribution.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Retrieve work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Create a new work item such as a task or bug.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Update the status of an existing work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Construct a full URL based on the API path.
